name: Macrofurin Nitrofurantoin 100mg — 40 Capsules
short: Macrofurin® nitrofurantoin 100 mg, 40 capsules — antibiotic indicated for urinary tract infections. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Macrofurin® is the Mexican brand of nitrofurantoin 100 mg, an antibiotic primarily indicated for the treatment and prevention of urinary tract infections caused by susceptible bacteria. Each capsule contains nitrofurantoin 100 mg, and this presentation includes 40 capsules.

Nitrofurantoin concentrates in the urinary tract and works by damaging bacterial DNA and disrupting essential bacterial enzymes. It is typically prescribed as a short course for acute uncomplicated UTIs or as a longer maintenance dose for recurrent infections. Always complete the full prescribed course; consult your healthcare provider for appropriate dosing and to confirm bacterial susceptibility.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout the Cabo region. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
